key_points: AMAT deepens AI chipmaking R&D with a major foundry partner, reinforcing its role in advanced manufacturing.
Jim Cramer commentary highlights AMAT's value beyond current earnings multiple, suggesting upside potential.
Analyst notes AMAT stock has doubled this year, trims price target but forecasts higher 2027 sales and profit.
Insider sales by controller (~$394k) and margin‑reset speculation from Goldman create modest short‑term headwinds.
Overall sentiment is mildly positive with incremental news rather than thesis‑changing developments.
